assessment.model_case: He went over 1.5 in three of four logged games on three to five targets, and the projection of 2.04 sits modestly above the line with small adjustments. Weeks 1 and 5 are absent and Week 2 had zero targets, so the role baseline rests on very few games.

assessment.context_case: The Bucs report affects the opponent only. A missing safety could help Carolina's passing game, while Mayfield's status shifts game script. Nothing sourced addresses Metchie himself.
blocking_checks: Metchie's availability and role: he missed or was absent in Weeks 1 and 5 with no Carolina report supplied. A reduced or uncertain snap share would undercut a projection built on four games.

qualitative_review.countercase: Four games, including a zero-target week, is a fragile base. If Mayfield sits and Carolina plays with a lead, pass volume could drop. If Metchie is a rotational receiver, two receptions is far from assured.

assessment.reason: Offered +260 beats the model's fair price near +215 and its minimum near +250. The low end of the sensitivity range still sits above the +260 break-even. Model and market are close, so this is a modest, unvalidated margin, not a large disagreement.
assessment.model_case: Projected mean is well under one assist, so the over needs one helper in a low-count market. About 17.8 projected minutes and a long appearance history support an expected regular role. Weakness: line and power-play assignment are unverified, and his history may not carry over to a depleted Florida lineup.
assessment.price_case: Single main line at 0.5. At +260 the break-even is a bit above one-in-four. Only one other book is available, and its no-vig price sits slightly below the model. Value depends on that small margin and on +260 holding; below about +250 the case lapses.
assessment.context_case: If Barkov's listed absence holds, Lundell may absorb top-center minutes, though linemate quality also drops. The listings are snapshots with unknown publication time. Lundell's own status and Chicago's starter are unconfirmed.

qualitative_review.countercase: With Florida's top forwards listed out, a bigger role may not produce more assists if the team's overall scoring falls. The model's edge over the market is small enough that a modest rate overestimate erases it, and one comparison book is not consensus.

assessment.model_case: Projected mean is under half an assist on about 24 minutes, so zero assists is the modal outcome. Weakness: a heavy-minute defenseman on the power play collects secondary assists. If his power-play usage exceeds what the model assumes, the under's margin shrinks.

The -120 price may already reflect this, and the model's larger edge could come from underrating his power-play role.

qualitative_review.countercase: The margin depends on a thin model edge at a price exactly at the minimum, so any line shuffle, reduced power-play time or a half-point price drop erases it. assessment.price_case: This is a single main line at -160 with heavy juice, and only one other book is quoted. The model's fair price is about -200, but its minimum of roughly -169 sits barely past the offer. After the 10-weight market blend, the edge is close to nothing.
assessment.context_case: The listings show multiple key Panthers forwards out long term. This may concentrate playmaking on Verhaeghe. The direction cuts against the under, and his power-play role is unverified.

qualitative_review.countercase: The low-end sensitivity case still clears -160. If his deployment matches recent games, the model's long-run rate could hold. A better price could revive a case for human review.

build.note: Ice time × production per 60 minutes, both recency-weighted and blended with a position average, then scaled by how many shots the opponent allows compared with the league. The model then turns this average into the chance of each count.
